label: Realization cuts to bearer esse pass to selected actual respects by last-group inversion (inference)
rule: Classify the selected act as a mode, then invert a supposed surviving supply derivation
meaning: An intrinsic last step contradicts the no-seed clause. An admitted group must have a supplied bearer-esse contributor even after restriction, contradicting loss of esse supply. The interface provides positive original supply. No claim about a cause of every other being follows.
